Links: skills.cat/skills/carolmonroe22/lovable-cloud-migration ; cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/carolmonroe22/lovable-cloud-migration@main/SKILL.md ; dreamlit.ai/tools/lovable-cloud-to-supabase-exporter ; supabase.com/docs/guides/troubleshooting/cant-access-supabase-project-lovable-cloud ; docs.lovable.dev/tips-tricks/self-hosting ; dreamlit.ai/changelog/lovable-cloud-to-supabase-exporter ; wz-it.com/en/knowledge/supabase/migrate-lovable-cloud-to-supabase/ ; dzone.com/articles/migration-from-lovable-cloud-to-supabase-1
Summary: "The search didn't turn up a launch date or launch announcement for Lovable Cloud." Lovable self-hosting guide says migration possible, starting with creating new Supabase project and updating env variables. Supabase troubleshooting page: no automated way to transfer a project, manual migration possible; once Cloud is enabled it cannot be disconnected or switched to an external Supabase connection; recommends avoiding Cloud if you plan to manage Supabase independently. Community skill (v4.0.2, tested July 2026) claims it can migrate whole Cloud project to own Supabase (schema, data, auth users, storage), then remove Cloud and connect own Supabase to same project; contradicts Supabase page; older version said Cloud is permanent. Free exporter tool (dreamlit) moves tables, auth users, storage; Lovable official guide still requires password reset email to every user plus manual table and storage work. Bottom line: migrating data is documented as possible but manual; whether Cloud can be removed from existing project unclear (sources conflict).
